text: PR #5464 open (issue #5424, dedupe read-loop/identity-recheck logic in physical_path_containment.cpp): extracted shared read_open_object_with_identity_recheck() used by both read_physically_contained_file_snapshot_from_handle() and read_physically_contained_file_snapshot(), replacing 4 near-duplicate 64KB read loops with 1. Preserved both callers' pre-existing behavioral differences (content_equal vs full identity comparison; read_failed vs indirect_component on info-query failure) via explicit params rather than unifying them, per the issue's no-behavior-change acceptance criteria. Also switched the string-reopening function to ScopedHandle/ScopedFd RAII. Local build + test_security_controls + the migrated-callsite regression suite all pass. Will merge once CI is green. Moving on to survey #5358 (VFP9 DESCENDING() index semantics, agent-approved) while CI runs.
